images.title: THE OCCUPATION OF PORT HAMILTON.
images.rights_evidence: 1885-05-18 홍콩 공표 일간지 기사(무기명). 공표 후 140년 — 보호기간 만료 명확(무기명 저작물 공표 후 70년). 사본: Internet Archive 'NPCM18850518'(china-mail 컬렉션, 홍콩대 구 신문 디지털화본 업로드)
visible: 'The Home papers—notably the Times, the St James's Gazette, and the Pall Mall Gazette—have got sadly confused about the occupation of Port Hamilton by the British Admiral.'
'Sir Harry Parkes did good service when he obtained, as almost the last public act of his life, the cession of Port Hamilton from the Chinese Emperor.' (인용된 Times 문단)
'We believe, also, that while Port-Hamilton belongs to Corea, Quelpart is Japanese territory.'
